intro: Professionals and everyday users convert mpg (us) (MPG (US)) to kilometers per liter (km/L) when working across us_customary and metric standards in comparing North American EPA window stickers against European WLTP and UK vehicle fuel consumption figures. One miles per gallon (us) equals 0.425144 kilometers per liter, while 1 kilometers per liter equals 2.352146 mpg (us). Whether you are verifying fuel economy specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: US Customary vs. British Imperial Liquid Volume Trap
items: US Customary and UK Imperial liquid units share identical names but have different physical volumes: 1 US Gallon is 3.78541 L (128 US fl oz), whereas 1 UK Imperial Gallon is 4.54609 L (160 Imp fl oz) — a 20.1% difference.

Similarly, 1 US Pint contains 16 US fluid ounces (473.18 mL), while 1 British Imperial Pint contains 20 Imperial fluid ounces (568.26 mL). Always verify whether your recipe, pump datasheet, or vehicle spec sheet uses US or UK standards.

faqs.question: How many kilometers per liter (km/L) are in 1 miles per gallon (us) (MPG (US))?
faqs.answer: There are 0.4251437 kilometers per liter (km/L) in 1 miles per gallon (us) (MPG (US)), which rounds to 0.4251 km/L for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 kilometers per liter equals 2.352146 mpg (us).

faqs.question: How do I convert mpg (us) to kilometers per liter (MPG (US) to km/L)?
faqs.answer: To convert mpg (us) to kilometers per liter, use the formula: km/L = MPG (US) × 0.4251437. For example, converting 20 MPG (US) gives 8.5029 km/L.

faqs.question: What is 20 mpg (us) in kilometers per liter?
faqs.answer: 20 mpg (us) (MPG (US)) equals exactly 8.5029 kilometers per liter (km/L) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
